what: Which ONNX graphs bolo runs are affected by ONNX Runtime's uint8 x int8 kernel on x86 CPUs with AVX2 but without VNNI (pairs of products added in 16 bits, which saturate), and whether session.x64quantprecision=1 fixes them
conditions: onnxruntime 1.31.1 and sherpa-onnx 2.0.1 (Python 3.13); native: 4 vCPU x86_64 with AVX-512 VNNI and AVX-VNNI; without VNNI: qemu-x86_64 8.2 -cpu Haswell (AVX2, no VNNI) on the same machine; the catalog's files at the pinned revisions

graphs.integer_ops: QDQ: 78 QuantizeLinear, 114 DequantizeLinear; int8 weights of 26 MatMul, 2 Conv, 3 Gemm (62 int8 and 78 uint8 initializers); ONNX Runtime fuses them into uint8 x int8 kernels
graphs.result: 34 windows of the bundled en-long, hi-short and en-short samples (1 s steps of 0.5 s, up to 12 s): without the option the probability moved by up to 0.572 (mean 0.123) and 4 of 34 decisions at 0.5 flipped (0.34 -> 0.68, 0.21 -> 0.76, 0.11 -> 0.53, 0.38 -> 0.96); with it, identical to native. Native with and without the option: identical.

graphs.integer_ops: 127 MatMulNBits (bits 8, block 32, accuracy_level unset); 254 uint8 initializers; no MatMulInteger, ConvInteger, DynamicQuantizeLinear or QLinear operators
graphs.result: speaker probabilities of 12 s of en-long: max difference to native 6.6e-7, with or without the option; native identical with the option

graphs.engine: LFM3-Audio-2B (s2s_onnx, precision q4, the files the catalog serves)

graphs.integer_ops: 154 MatMulNBits (126 with bits 4, 28 with bits 8; accuracy_level 4) and 1 GatherBlockQuantized; 308 uint8 initializers
graphs.exposed: not by this kernel; the option does not touch MatMulNBits
graphs.result: a 20-token chat prompt and 6 greedy tokens: the same text everywhere ('The capital of France is Paris'); under emulation the first logits differ from native by up to 1.12 (largest logit 20.5, correlation 0.998), identically with and without the option; native identical with the option
both halves are opened through bolo.ort_providers.create_session, so they carry the option

graphs.engine: speaker embeddings for diarization and voice-clone similarity (sherpa-onnx)
sherpa-onnx int8 models (whisper-tiny.en as the sample)
graphs.exposed: in principle (uint8 x int8 MatMulInteger, in sherpa-onnx's own ONNX Runtime, which takes no session option from bolo)
graphs.result: en-short (3 s) and en-long (first 25 s) under emulation: the same text as native, word for word

not_checked: the other int8 sherpa-onnx models of the catalog (Whisper, Moonshine, Zipformer, Paraformer, NeMo, SenseVoice, Kokoro and KittenTTS int8 ...) were not run under emulation; faster-whisper quantizes with CTranslate2's own kernels, outside ONNX Runtime; the LFM3-Audio q8 graphs (not served by the catalog) were not downloaded
fix: every session bolo opens itself sets session.x64quantprecision=1 (bolo.ort_providers.session_options, exact_int8 and create_session)
